I visited a few shops already, but I’m still almost 20 batteries short. Should I just go back and pray that some of the batteries survived 5 years of constant work or keep on searching? 
It’s cold, but I can’t give up now. In a city this big it shouldn’t be a problem finding these batteries.
If I take a shortcut to the closest supermarket I should be able to get it done soon.
